about: Not a frame check: tools/r278-dolly/film.sh films it with libGDX (shots/ParallaxShots, through tools/ai-film.sh) and stacks the two films side by side.

scenes.name: calm-dolly
scenes.about: the film attached to r278: Calm (round1 s10, nine layers) dollied: the near forest grows, the far peaks barely, the sky not at all, filmed after the 12 s still for 8 s at 30 fps while the zoom goes on in from 1 to 0.7 (straight from 1.45 at 0 s to 1 at 12 s: 0.0375 a second)

scenes.name: calm-plain-zoom
scenes.about: the film attached to r278: the same without the dolly: the page zooms as one picture, about the view's bottom left corner, filmed after the 12 s still for 8 s at 30 fps while the zoom goes on in from 1 to 0.7 (straight from 1.45 at 0 s to 1 at 12 s: 0.0375 a second)
